name: ai-resume-screening-system
description: Enterprise AI-Powered Resume Screening and Applicant Tracking System

scripts.dev:backend: node -e "const p = process.platform === 'win32' ? '.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : '.venv/bin/python'; require('child_process').spawn(p, ['-m', 'uvicorn', 'app.main:app', '--host', '0.0.0.0', '--port', '8000', '--reload'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.init:db: node -e "const p = process.platform === 'win32' ? '.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : '.venv/bin/python'; require('child_process').spawnSync(p, ['init_db.py'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit' })"
